purpose: Keep T2 recall broad, but prevent one hot subchain from flooding the formal common qualification pool with near-duplicate companies.

weekly_deep_review.rule: Weekly deep review is an independent positive signal, so a weekly-validated company receives priority when competing inside a T2 subchain. But it does not create unlimited slots: every company carrying that T2 tag remains subject to the same representative cap. Weekly-only names with no active T2 tag remain independently eligible.

ranking.rule: Representative selection balances absolute profit scale with current earnings transmission. Profit scale is deliberately weighted heavily so low-base percentage growth cannot crowd out established industry representatives. Weekly deep-review evidence gets priority only inside the same T2 cap. Valuation and right-side technical structure are never used here, preserving stage independence.

output_policy.rule: Deferred companies remain visible in future_earnings_gate for auditability but are excluded from common_pool_codes. Multi-tag companies remain subject to every subchain cap; winning one chain cannot be used to overfill another.
